additional_info.subject: 0456277 - ID0456277-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R5 170001872] Display damaged CRM:01223000389
additional_info.body:
Hi Luis,
we got a problem with a  customer from DE.
The costumer has a charger where the display is broken. So we write a offer for a display exchange because in our oppinion it was vandalism.
Now the customer reached out to us because he said its no vandalism. He says that the display broke due to pressure caused by incorrect installation.
Now my question. Are you aware of any cases where a display has broken due to pressure, and has this been investigated?
Best regards
Markus

additional_info.subject: warten bis luis antwortet. Danach entscheiden was gemacht wird
RE: 0456277 - ID0456277-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R5 170001872] Display damaged CRM:01223000389
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
Earlier this calendar year, we received something similar (ISP 0399056 -> EQM 1178845)
Few notes:
This screen that we sent to supplier for analysis we still didn’t have a reply of this analysis, as there’s an escalation on Supplier Claim Management with this supplier (Novitronic [regarding Halo and delamination])
Leipzig colleagues provided us feedback that these cases(when they reply) that supplier also usually assigns the defect as vandalism (the picture below is for ISP 0399056)
I see that the charger you’re presenting was manufactured in June 2023, so even if this was a manufacturing problem it’s hard to evidence anything at all on a charger (and specially an LCD) out of warranty
If there’s more units with this defect in the past, we don’t have this visibility as LPZ was lead factory. However if previous supplier was a known reoccurring issue, the corrective action assigned and implemented is the new generation of blackpanels
With best regards,
Luis Miguel Vieira da Silva

2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
Mobile: +351 915240877
